rules.reason: Selected day and display mode do not replace the landing page's year, month, download collection or public context.
Selectable calculations remain interactive states. Existing dedicated city paths retain their own canonical identity.
Shared school breaks restore the published academic year and grade; university links restore the chosen institution and published schedule. These public selections do not create new editorial pages.
Name search is a local filter over published VVC data; the general name directory and existing month pages remain separate landing pages.

Filtered subsets and ordering do not create separately maintained landing pages. The public PDF library uses the Latvian keys gads, periods, menesis, virziens, svetki and dizains; English example keys do not enable those filters.
User-selected inputs are functional calculator states, not new editorial documents.
The generic maker remains public. Names and personal draft content must not enter metadata, structured data, analytics or sitemaps; generated files stay in the browser.
No server pagination currently exists. Re-evaluate this rule before adding real page-numbered content; never canonicalize real page 2 to page 1 by default.
Existing print controls and actual static file URLs retain their own behaviors. A query key alone is not a separate document.
Tracking keys do not change primary content. No analytics service is enabled by this policy.

unsupportedParameters: Ignored state keys retain the landing canonical. This policy does not promise UI support for parameters that the existing tool does not read.
